run_activ_retrieval: run the activ-retrieval script to retrieve images with maximal activations for a given model and dataset
run_parse_args: run parse_args to build an argparse parser for activ-retrieval CLI arguments like data, model, conv, exp, count, and workers
run_main: run main to load a model, compute layer activations across a dataset, and save top-N images per filter
run_forward: run forward to extract per-channel activation scores from a specified ReLU layer in a model's feature modules
review_forward: review the forward function to understand how it iterates over model features and extracts channel-wise mean activations
